# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021)</sub>
- **Role:** Mistress and household manager of Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c8 P8](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0008), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

She is described as a gaunt woman with graying hair. She dresses simply and presents a stern, grim expression.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015)_

## Personality

Marilla is practical, firm, strict, and strongly committed to traditional decorum and moral discipline. Though initial appearances present her as grim and unemotional, she possesses deep emotional warmth, resilience, and a dry, quiet sense of humor. Over time, her stern exterior softens through her care for Anne Shirley.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028)_

## Traits

- Practical and no-nonsense  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013)</sub>
- Strict disciplinarian  <sub>[v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c9 P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022)</sub>
- Unimaginative  <sub>[v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015), [v1 c8 P17](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0017)</sub>
- Compassionate and soft-hearted beneath a stern exterior  <sub>[v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028)</sub>

## Abilities

- Managing household domestic duties and chores  <sub>[v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000)</sub>
- Farm chores, including milking cows  <sub>[v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Goals

- Raise Anne Shirley properly and teach her obedience and discipline  <sub>[v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c19 P90](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0090)</sub>
- Maintain the Green Gables household  <sub>[v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert arranged alongside her brother, Matthew Cuthbert, to adopt an orphan boy from an asylum to help on their farm at Green Gables. However, due to a misunderstanding, Mrs. Spencer brought them an orphan girl named Anne Shirley instead. Although Marilla initially intended to return Anne or place her with Mrs. Blewett, she pitied the child's past neglect and agreed to keep her. She took on the duty of raising Anne, enforcing strict domestic discipline, religious instruction, and schooling. Despite frequent clashes over Anne's vivid imagination and temper, Marilla defended her against outside criticism and gradually grew deeply attached to her. She managed Green Gables while guiding Anne into young adulthood.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c9 P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028)_

## Background by volume

- Lived at Green Gables alongside her brother Matthew Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020)</sub>
- Followed her father's belief that children should not go to school before seven years old  <sub>[v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007)</sub>

## Quotes

> I think you’d better learn to control that imagination of yours, Anne, if you can’t distinguish between what is real and what isn’t.  <sub>[v1 c6 P24](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0024)</sub>

> Matthew and I have decided to keep you—that is, if you will try to be a good little girl and show yourself grateful.  <sub>[v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005)</sub>

> No; you’ll call me just plain Marilla. I’m not used to being called Miss Cuthbert and it would make me nervous.  <sub>[v1 c8 P9](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0009)</sub>

> I don’t believe in imagining things different from what they really are. When the Lord puts us in certain circumstances He doesn’t mean for us to imagine them away.  <sub>[v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019)</sub>

> You shouldn’t have twitted her about her looks, Rachel.  <sub>[v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026)</sub>
